sources.title: File URLs
sources.description: Public URLs of PDFs or images (PNG, JPG, WebP, TIFF, GIF, BMP, HEIC/HEIF, AVIF). PDFs are rendered to images; images are converted to the output format. Files in your own Apify key-value store work too: set the store's access to "Anyone with ID can read" and use https://api.apify.com/v2/key-value-stores/<store ID>/records/<key>.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: png, jpg, webp or tiff for PDF pages and images; pdf to turn images into PDF.

dpi.title: DPI for PDF pages
dpi.description: Rendering resolution: 72 = screen thumbnail, 150 = good default, 300 = print quality.

pages.title: PDF pages
pages.description: Pages to render, e.g. "1-3,5,8-". Empty = all pages.

maxWidth.title: Max width (px)
maxWidth.description: Downscale wider images to this width, keeping the aspect ratio. 0 = keep size.

mergeImagesIntoOnePdf.title: Merge images into one PDF
mergeImagesIntoOnePdf.description: With output format "pdf": also return merged.pdf with all input images in order (free).

zipAll.title: ZIP of all output files
zipAll.description: Also return all-files.zip with every produced file (free).
